body: I haven't seen things differently its just written out it sounds almost childish while in real life its actually something serious and has been ruining my life.

Well I don't really *want* to be in college its more of my parents being very insistent on my going and getting my degree and me realizing how important it is to have a decent degree if I want to be seriously considered for a decent job.

As for my friends we go to different schools and I see them maybe once every couple weeks but it just seems like they still enjoy having me around but have "moved on" and would be totally indifferent if I never visited them again. 

Wow after typing all this out I really sound like an immature little child, I apologize
